# Synthetic nuclear-medicine DICOM fixtures

These are tiny, wholly synthetic static NM images used for non-optional
`pylinac.nuclear` regression tests. They are deliberately narrower than the
local-only IAEA NMQC archive: they exercise a uniform planar field and a
FourBar-style pair of perpendicular profiles, not clinical or acceptance-test
validation.

| File | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `synthetic_nm_planar_uniformity.dcm` | Full, near-uniform field for `PlanarUniformity`. |
| `synthetic_nm_four_bar_resolution.dcm` | 1.0 mm pixels with two Gaussian peaks 100 mm apart on both axes for `FourBarResolution`. |

## Provenance and regeneration

Both files are generated only from NumPy arrays and fixed synthetic DICOM
metadata by [`tests/scripts/generate_nuclear_nm_fixtures.py`](../../scripts/generate_nuclear_nm_fixtures.py).
Regenerate from the repository root with the project virtual environment active:

```bash
python tests/scripts/generate_nuclear_nm_fixtures.py
```

## Privacy and scope

The generator uses fixed synthetic patient identifiers, fixed synthetic UIDs,
and no private tags. No vendor, institution, clinical, or acquired data is
used. Review any regenerated bytes under the repository PHI/PII guardrails and
update `security/approved-media-sha256.json` only after that review.
